title: Segmentation fault in 'flatbuffer_loader.cpp:298'

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Hi! We've been fuzzing PyTorch project with [sydr-fuzz](https://github.com/ispras/oss-sydr-fuzz).
We've found a hcrash at `flatbuffer_loader.cpp:298` in jit module.

The crash occurs because of null pointer dereference when accessing some fields of malformed flatbuffers-module.

PyTorch version: cdf7f3e78032a17600f701e9153e9bb49fad8ce7

OS: Ubuntu 20.04

How to reproduce

1. Build docker from [here](https://github.com/ispras/oss-sydr-fuzz/tree/master/projects/pytorch) and run the container:

        sudo docker build -t oss-sydr-fuzz-pytorch .
        sudo docker run --privileged --rm -v `pwd`:/fuzz -it oss-sydr-fuzz-pytorch /bin/bash

2. Run the target on this input: [crash.txt](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/files/12686335/crash.txt)

        /load_afl crash.txt

3. You will see the following output:
